statement: Docling offers a single structured intermediate representation across many document types.
actakit_implication: Strong candidate for the built-in structured-document framework behind ActaKit Representations.
ActaKit can own policy/provenance while reusing Docling internals rather than creating another document engine framework.

statement: Docling explicitly warns that its numeric confidence scores are internal and may change, while grades are the intended interpretation.
actakit_implication: Ingest named QualityEvidence; never normalize Docling 0..1 to a universal ActaKit confidence.

statement: Docling code is MIT but enabled models have separate licenses.
actakit_implication: Processor capability registry must record model identity/license, not just Python package license.

statement: Docling can process audio/video but current limitations include no word-level timestamps in its export.
actakit_implication: Do not force all media through Docling if a direct ASR backend preserves better locator/quality evidence.
Pin exact versions/models and benchmark before freeze; avoid coupling core schema to Docling private objects.
